newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy to close STET merger, then concession.
newsitem.headline: Italy to close STET merger, then concession.

text.p: Italy will first complete the merger of state-controlled telecoms holding STET and Telecom Italia and then deal with the concession to operate for the combined group, said Italian Posts and Telecommunications Minister Antonio Maccanico.
STET and its majority-owned telephone operating company Telecom Italia are planned to merge this year in preparation for the privatisation of the combined group.
The concession to operate in the Italian telephone market is currently with Telecom Italia up to 2012, so this concession will have to be renegotiated for the merged company.
"First we complete the merger and then we think about the concession," said Maccanico, replying to questions in the lower house of parliament.
